definition.text: Descent. (1.) The fourth antediluvian patriarch in descent from Seth (Gen. 5:15-20; Luke 3:37), the father of Enoch; called Jered in 1 Chr. 1:2. (2.) A son of Ezra probably (1 Chr. 4:18).

lemmas.gloss: Jered, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite
to live, whether literally or figuratively
lemmas.kjv: keep  alive, certainly, give  life, live
